family_name: Ionic-liquid constituent identity and site membership
family_summary: Ionic-liquid constituent identity and site membership.

rules.purpose: Rejects duplicate normalized composition and charge within an ionic species group.
Requires non-vacancy neutrals for single-site terms, or cations on site 1 and anions or neutrals on site 2 for two-site terms.
Requires zero formal charge for vacancy composition Va, independently of the species name.
